statement: For all integer partitions lam, mu, nu with at most 6 parts each and |lam| = |mu| + |nu| <= 30, every coefficient of the stretched Littlewood-Richardson polynomial P(t) = c^{t lam}_{t mu, t nu} in the monomial basis is nonnegative; proved by an exhaustive computation in which every polynomial is computed by two independent programs (Normaliz on the hive polytope; lrcalc by the classical rule with exact interpolation) and the enumeration's completeness is recounted independently for every size.
novelty: study/problem.md, queries Q1-Q17 (2026-09-03), and novelty.md, queries 1-13 (2026-09-03) and unit-level queries U1-U6 (2026-09-04): no source reports a certified computation over the box or its part with at most 6 parts; the nearest results are Ferudun 2026 (arXiv:2607.22301, positivity for length <= 4 for all sizes, plus uncertified computations without ranges), De Loera-McAllister 2006 (LattE computations at small rank), and the ktt-positivity repository (a ~4 x 10^8-triple search without ranges).
